black_level.note: Known black of this body type; the free photon-transfer intercept reads 1977, black minus the read-noise term.

clip.note: Raw value the histogram piles up at; WHTLVLN reads 11765.

gain.note: 24 MP class at a 13583 clip value. This camera: own shared fit 2.25-2.33 per channel over 1 sequence(s), no clean sequence in the sample. Sky photon transfer is a lower bound and its method floor is ~10%; replace with a flat-field photon transfer (panoptes/panoptes-pipeline#99). Only one dark sequence per camera in the archive, so the camera's own number is weak.

read_noise.note: Photon-transfer intercept with black fixed; indicative to a few e-.
